observed./mnt/d/ClaudeWork/rimmandrake/art_eval/r: A large fungal tree on a transparent background. A thick, twisted trunk made of braided mauve-brown fibrous strands rises from a wide spread of root-like tendrils that curl outward along the bottom edge. The crown is a cluster of five or six pale cream, bulbous, petal-like cap lobes. Their inner faces are deep purple with a honeycomb or morel-like pitting. Small tan and purple spore balls float around the crown. The palette is muted cream, mauve and plum. It is painted, with soft shading and a thin dark edge. There is no ground patch or shadow. The picture is small (about 240 px of visible height), so the native resolution is about 32 px per cell.

Beside the vanilla human at max zoom (46 px/cell) and at normal play (32 px/cell), the tree spans roughly 7–8 cells wide and tall and stands several times the human's height. The cream lobes, the purple pitting, the twisted trunk and the root spread all read clearly at 32 px/cell. At 46 px/cell it is still fairly crisp.

SIGNATURE.seen: A towering pale fungal crown with spore balls drifting around it, and pale hyphae-like tendrils spreading outward from the base. All the elements the description names are present.

READS_KIND.seen: A clear trunk plus an elevated crown of cap lobes. It reads as a fungal tree, not a lump.

NATURAL.seen: Organic braided fibres, irregular lobes and pitting. Nothing looks built.

ANCHOR.seen: The trunk sits at bottom centre and the root tendrils spread across the bottom edge. Nothing is cut off and it does not float.

NO_SCENERY.seen: Real alpha with no soil disc, rock or shadow. The floating particles are the spores the description names.

ALIEN.seen: Petal-like cap lobes with morel-style honeycomb interiors on a braided hyphal trunk. It is not any Earth tree or mushroom species.

STYLE.seen: Painterly shading with a thin dark edge and a realistic fibrous texture. It is not cel-shaded or cute.

OURS.seen: A bespoke design matching the Rot palette. It does not resemble vanilla or known donor art.

FILLS.seen: The subject fills most of the square canvas, with a modest margin for the drifting spores.

SCALE.seen: About 8 cells, several times the human's height, which fits 'vast elder… towering overhead'.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px/cell the crown lobes, the purple interiors, the trunk and the roots are all distinct.

observed.single.png: A huge mushroom-shaped growth on a transparent background. It has a broad dome cap in olive, ochre and brown, with a pitted, mossy and crusted top. Thick, viscous strands drip from the cap's rim. The underside shows radiating gills lit a warm glowing yellow-cream. The stalk is thick and fibrous, twisted, riddled with holes and pores, and widens into a buttressed, root-like flare at the bottom edge. A uniform heavy black outline surrounds the whole silhouette. The interior is rendered in an illustrative, painterly way, slightly comic-book in its line weight. It is centred, fills the canvas, and nothing is cut off. There is no ground patch.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom (48 px per cell crop), the mushroom spans about 8 cells wide and is roughly 4–5 times the height of the vanilla human beside it. At normal play (32 px per cell), it still reads clearly as a giant mushroom tree with a glowing underside; the dark outline and the bright gills carry the silhouette.

SIGNATURE.seen: The towering cap of a vast fungal elder is the dominant feature. The base has a fibrous root flare, but no distinct pale hyphae spreading from it, and no spore cloud (spores are probably an effect rather than part of the sprite).

READS_KIND.seen: A clear trunk-like stalk and a broad cap read as a giant tree-mushroom, not a lump.

NATURAL.seen: Organic pitted textures, dripping rim and twisted fibres; nothing looks man-made.

ANCHOR.seen: The stalk flares into a root base centred at the bottom edge; nothing is cut off and nothing floats.

NO_SCENERY.seen: Real alpha, with no soil, disc or shadow under the base.

ALIEN.seen: A dripping, porous, glowing-gilled colossal fungus. It is not a recognisable Earth mushroom species.

STYLE.seen: The interior is painterly and detailed. The outline is heavy and black, leaning illustrative, but this is not cute or flat cel shading.

OURS.seen: Bespoke art matching the description. It is not a vanilla or donor sprite I recognise.

FILLS.seen: The subject fills the canvas edge to edge (visible alpha height 380 px).

SCALE.seen: It towers several times over the human, which fits 'vast elder, cap towering overhead'.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px per cell the silhouette, cap and glowing gills read clearly.
